name: Google Image
description: A Gemini image model draws the picture of a Generated Image. The key is in the Google AI settings.

properties.name: imageModel
properties.title: Image Model
properties.description: The Gemini image models your API key may use. The picture is drawn at the shape Google offers nearest the panel's, with a blurred margin for the rest.

properties.name: quality
properties.title: Quality
properties.description: The size Google draws at: Auto 1K, High 2K, Maximum 4K (higher costs more). A model that does not take the size uses the nearest one below it.
